Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (MPA + procurement path)

Samir / Nina, great demo today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap: walked through Redwood hosted API, Dedicated options, and Private/VPC deployment patterns relevant to AcmeCloud's regulated workflows. You flagged security questionnaire, SOC 2 evidence, and PO/contract path as blockers for procurement.
- Immediate asks (from AcmeCloud): procurement timeline, who owns legal/security/finance reviews, and whether we can start on a card for initial pilot while the PO is processed.

Attached: redwood_mpa_acmecloud_v1.xlsx (draft MPA) and redwood_procurement_timeline.pdf (proposed timeline).

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Legal review of SOW / Svc Agreement (owner: Acme legal + Redwood legal) target: 2 weeks
2) Security review (questionnaire + SOC2 evidence) (owner: Acme security + Redwood security) target: 1-2 weeks in parallel
3) Finance / purchasing (PO issuance or card setup) (owner: Acme finance) target: 1-2 weeks after legal sign-off
4) Contract signature / PO issuance (owner: Acme + Redwood) target: issuance within 1 week of approvals

Can you confirm: (a) whether procurement requires a PO for pilot vs card payment; (b) any blackout dates or fiscal processes we should be aware of; (c) best contact for legal and procurement so we can loop them into the MPA?

Happy to run a short MPA check-in cadence (bi-weekly) suggested first check-in next Tue 6/29.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Samir Patel <s.patel@acmecloud.com>

Cc: Nina Torres <n.torres@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (MPA + procurement path)

Thanks Marissa - good recap. A few notes from procurement/security side: 

- AcmeCloud procurement prefers a PO for anything beyond a $5k monthly commitment. For pilots < $5k we generally allow corporate card but need an approved budget line and sponsorship from the BU leader.
- Our typical internal path is: Legal review -> Security & privacy review -> Finance approval -> PO issuance. Legal usually budgets ~2 weeks, security depends on questionnaire complexity (1-3 weeks), finance depends on PO template and budget window (1 week if all docs in order).
- Please send SOC2 docs and completed security questionnaire. Also send a redlined PO or our PO template and your standard Svc Agreement; legal will redline.

Contact list: 
- Legal: Nina Torres (n.torres@acmecloud.com) - I included her.
- Procurement/Finance: procurement@acmecloud.com
- Security: sec-requests@acmecloud.com (I'll loop them in once we share the questionnaire)

We can start a card-based pilot if we get BU sponsorship. Otherwise PO will be required; we'll aim to move quickly but want to set realistic expectations.

Samir
Director, Cloud Partnerships
AcmeCloud

Appreciate the clarity Samir - that matches our expectations. A couple of clarifications and items we can own to speed things up: 

- We've attached the SOC2-report-2025.pdf and a completed security questionnaire (see spreadsheet tab in redwood_mpa_acmecloud_v1.xlsx). Laura, our legal lead, is copied to start the agreement thread.
- Commercial options we can support immediately:
  * Card pilot (single BU) - up to $5k/month, immediate activation after card onboarding
  * Month-to-month via card with later PO conversion
  * 12-month committed PO (preferred for predictable pricing & reserved capacity)
  * Marketplace (AWS Marketplace) - if you prefer procurement via marketplace, we can provide listing details; note that marketplace may add invoicing/contract nuances and slightly slower payment flows.

Proposed refined timeline & owners (we can update the MPA spreadsheet):
- 2026-06-22 - Share SOC2 + questionnaire + Redwood Svc Agreement draft (done) 
- 2026-06-23 to 2026-07-06 - Legal review window (2 wks) - owner: Acme legal + Redwood legal (Laura)
- 2026-06-24 to 2026-07-08 - Security review (parallel) - owner: Acme security + Redwood security
- 2026-07-07 to 2026-07-14 - Finance review & PO setup (owner: Acme finance)
- 2026-07-15 - Target PO issuance / contract signature (contingent on approvals)

We can accept a PO in AcmeCloud’s standard template - please send the template or a sample PO. If you want, we can start the pilot on a card as soon as BU sponsorship is confirmed; that would buy time while legal/security run.

I’ll update the MPA spreadsheet with these milestones and owners. Suggested weekly or bi-weekly 30-min check-ins - whichever you prefer.

Thanks,
Marissa
